strings.네, 그럭저럭요. 그럼 더 쉬러 가볼게요. 어, 그런데 손에 든 건 뭐죠: Well enough. I'll go rest some more. Oh, what's in your hand? A letter?
strings.너한테 편지가 왔어. 양식을 보니 이스트랜드의 것은 아닌데…. 이거 혹시: A letter for you. The format isn't from Eastland... Is it from another continent?
Let me see, and I'll tell you.
strings.(샤이닉이 편지를 곱게 줄 생각은 없는지 이리저리 살펴본다.): (Shynic inspects the letter from every angle, apparently in no hurry to hand it over.)
strings.그런데 이 사람 뭔데, 왜 하트 모양으로 봉인한 거야?: Who is this person? Why seal it with a heart?
strings.안 그래도 심심했거든. 그래서 누구라는 거야? 응?: I was bored. So who is it? Hmm?
strings.지엔디아 대륙의 아틀란티스라는 도시에서 조상들의 역사를 연구하는 역사학자: A historian in Atlantis, a city in Jiendia, who studies her ancestors' past. She's researching a city lost in an ancient undersea explosion.
strings.도시의 이름은 코랄시티…. 그런데 그 도시가 짠 하고 아틀란티스 인근에: Coral City... Except it suddenly reappeared near Atlantis.
Really? Coral City, you said? I feel like I've heard that name...
Am I getting close to death? Ugh, I don't know.
strings.후후, 명왕 샤이닉이나 되니까 이런 농담도 할 수 있는 거야. 그럼 계속: Hehe. Only Shynic, Queen of the Underworld, could make that joke. Keep going. This person sounds interesting...
strings.아틀란티스의 아이돌같은 사람이에요. 미모가 뛰어나서 모든 남자들이 줄서서: She's like an idol in Atlantis. So beautiful that men line up to ask her on dates...
strings.코랄시티 주민의 먼 후손이라 그런지 몰라도 다른 사람들과 달리 다시 발견: Perhaps because she's a distant descendant of Coral City's people, she can enter the rediscovered city when others can't.
Even the creatures revived as spirits don't attack her. Strange, isn't it?
Well, I have the goddess's protection...
strings.넌 재미없으니까 편지 읽고 무슨 이야기인지 얘기해줘. 응? 응?: You're boring. Read the letter and tell me what it says. Come on, come on.
Nothing much. Just, 'Please come see me after reading this'...
What?! I was hoping for something fun.
It can't be helped. I'll be going.
strings.그래. 갔다가 재미있는 일 같은 거 생기면 꼭 이야기해주기야. 알았지?: If anything interesting happens, be sure to tell me. Understood? You know what happens if you don't, right? ♡
Yes, yes. Don't worry. I'll find an interesting story.
strings.(오랜만에 코랄시티로 가보자. 엘레나는 잘 있겠지?): (It's been a while. Back to Coral City. I hope Elena's well.)
strings.뭐지, 이 울림은…? 아, 그분이구나!: What's this trembling...? Ah, it's you!
Oh, you knew I was coming? You sound like you were waiting...
The waves seemed to change when you arrived. Anyway, welcome! It's been so long!
strings.이렇게 오셨다는 건 제 편지를 받아보셨다는 거겠죠?: Since you're here, you must have received my letter?
strings.코랄시티의 비밀을 알려주겠다고 쓰여 있어서 서둘러 왔어요. 확실히 보통: It said you'd reveal Coral City's secret, so I hurried over. This must be important.
strings.네, 맞아요. 보통 일이 아니에요. 많은 분들이 저랑 식사하고 데이트를: Yes. Very important. So many people asked me to dine or go on dates, but I simply couldn't.
Since discovering this, I truly haven't been able to do anything else.
strings.제가 알고 있던 코랄시티의 다른 모습을 발견하게 된 것 같아요. 정확하지: I think I've discovered another side of the Coral City I knew. I wasn't certain, so I've been puzzling over it.
strings.게다가 모험가님의 도움이 아니면 조금 힘들기도 해서…. 이렇게 와주셨다니: And it's difficult without your help... Thank you so much for coming.
strings.절 잊지 않으셨으니까 이렇게 와주신거겠죠?: You came because you hadn't forgotten me, right?
You don't have to answer. I'll explain what needs doing.
strings.아, 바로 다녀올게요. 필요한 물건이 뭐죠?: I'll go right away. What do you need?
strings.아직 이야기가 다 끝나지도 않았는데…. 감사드려요. 제가 필요한 물건은…: I haven't even finished... Thank you. What I need is...
strings.트윙키브에서 '유전자 마법 연구서'와 '마법의 바다 물방울'을 찾아서 저: Could you find the 'Genetic Magic Research Notes' and a 'Magical Sea Droplet' in Twinkive and bring them here?
strings.제가 아무리 코랄시티 주민의 후손이라지만, 갈 수 있는 장소는 여기가 한: Even as a descendant of Coral City's people, this is as far as I can go.
I remember bringing you these before.
strings.기억하시는군요. 맞아요. 그런데, 이 물건이 코랄시티를 벗어나면서 어째선: You remember. Yes. But somehow, when they left Coral City, they crumbled to powder and became useless.
So I brought the books and materials from my workshop here instead.
strings.제가 그동안 해놓은게 있어서 그 사실을 알려드리는 건 그리 오래 걸리지: I've already done some work, so it shouldn't take long to explain the discovery.
strings.고대 코랄시티에 있었던 기록이 조금씩 보이고 있어요. 하지만, 뭔가를 숨: Records of ancient Coral City are gradually emerging. But some things remain hidden, as though concealed deliberately.
strings.잔뜩 단서가 있는데 막혀 있어요. 이 때의 기억을 마치 잠가버린 것처럼…: There are so many clues, yet they're blocked. As if the memories of that time were locked away...
strings.(이 책도 기억을 잃어버린 건가, 아니면 누군가 보여주고 싶지 않은 걸까: (Did this book lose its memories, too? Or does someone not want us to see them?)
strings.마법적인 요소가 더 필요한 것 같은데…. 모험가님, 혹시 이런 거에 응용: I think we need another magical element... Do you know a magical tool we could use?
Oh, adventurer? That expression says you know something.
strings.아, 그게 기억이라고 해서 생각나는 물건이 하나 있긴 해요. 그런데 이게: Well, you mentioned memories, and an item came to mind. But I don't know if it'll help the book I brought you.
Could you help once more, just in case? This may concern Goddess Seres...
strings.아, 그렇다면 바로 다녀올게요. 여기 계실 거죠?: Then I'll go immediately. You'll be here?
Of course. I'll stay here and wait.
All right. I'll go fetch what we need.
They hurry off whenever I mention the goddess. Did something happen...?
You certainly make your arrival known, adventurer.
strings.코랄시티를 감싸는 해류가 있는데, 모험가님이 오실 때면 흐름이 바뀌는 건: There's a current surrounding Coral City. Whenever you arrive, its flow seems to shift or tremble slightly.
strings.그래요? 다른 사람은 어떻게 느끼는지 조금 궁금하긴 하네요. 지금 이곳에: I'd be curious how someone else feels it. But you're the only person besides me who can enter now...
strings.그것보다 더 중요한게 있으니 신경쓰지 마세요. 그래서 모험가님께서 구해오: Never mind. We have more important things. What did you bring? ♬
strings.될지 모르겠지만, 엘레나가 가지고 있는 자료들을 보여주시겠어요?: I don't know if it'll work, but could you show me your materials?
strings.어떻게 하실지 모르겠지만, 정말 기대돼요!: I don't know what you'll do, but I'm excited!
strings.여기 이 물건을 자료들 위에 올려놓기만 할 거에요. 그러면 알아서 답을: I'll simply place this on the materials. Then it should find the answer itself. I can't be sure it'll work...
All I can do is trust and hope...
strings.(엘레나가 내민 자료 위에 '기억의 파편'을 올려놓는다. 잠시 후, 작은: (You place the Memory Fragment on Elena's materials. After a moment, it glows faintly and seeps into the documents.)
strings.(엘레나가 자료를 모아 훑어보더니 당황한다.): (Elena gathers the materials, scans them, and looks startled.)
strings.보이지 않았던 내용이 조금씩 보이기 시작해요. 이거 뭐죠? 아, 아니에요: The hidden contents are gradually appearing. What's this? Oh, never mind.
Ahem... I think I can explain now.
strings.사실 이 연구서는 고대 코랄시티에서 만들어진 것이 아니에요. 불과 몇 십: These research notes weren't created in ancient Coral City. The theory was developed in Atlantis only a few decades ago.
strings.아틀란티스에서 무슨 일이 일어났는지 혹시 아시나요?: Do you know what happened in Atlantis?
strings.알고 있어요. 잘못된 일을 했었죠. 그런데 코랄시티는 고대의 도시인데,: Yes. They did something wrong. But Coral City is ancient. How could...?
Exactly. Isn't it strange that someone thousands of years ago possessed this? What if an object from the future crossed time?
strings.이런 물건을 주민들이 가지고 있었다면, 오셀리노 왕이 모르고 있진 않았을: If the people had such objects, King Ocelino couldn't have been unaware.
strings.모두와 친구가 되길 바랐던 왕…. 세레스 여신이 소멸했을 때, 사라져버린: A king who wanted to befriend everyone... An undersea city that vanished when Goddess Seres disappeared...
strings.게다가 이걸 가지고 있던 가오리는 원래 일반적인 물고기였는데, 어떤 지는: And the ray carrying this was originally an ordinary fish. Somehow, it was enhanced and became a soldier of the king.
strings.조금 더 단서가 있으면 좋겠는데…. 혹시 이런 현상에 대해 아는 사람이: I wish we had another clue... Do you know anyone familiar with this kind of phenomenon?
Someone who can sense beings beyond time and space, with profound magical knowledge...
Someone comes to mind. Can you wait? It's rather far...
Of course. I'll examine the materials further while you're gone.
strings.(시간과 공간…, 이런 걸로 이야기 할 수 있는 사람은 아무래도 사이암: (Time and space... Siam is probably the only one I can ask about this.)
Welcome. Thank you for visiting so often.
If you've come to this space, it must be no small matter.
strings.코랄시티가 세레스 여신이 소멸하실 때에 사라졌다는 건 알겠소. 그런 도시: I understand that Coral City vanished when Goddess Seres disappeared. And that research notes on genetic magic, developed with Atlantean technology, were found there.
I also understand why the historian finds that strange.
strings.그런데, 만약에 말이오…. 반대로 아틀란티스의 기술이 고대의 물건을 바탕: But suppose the reverse were true... What if Atlantean technology was based on ancient objects?
strings.내 말도, 역사학자의 말도 모두 가설이오. 하지만 의심을 계속 해보는 수: Both her suggestion and mine are hypotheses. We must keep questioning... Far more inexplicable things happen in this world than people imagine.
strings.나를 이곳으로 이끈 것도, 그대가 이리스 양의 일을 하는 것도 모두…,: What brought me here, and your work for Iris... All such things.
Elena, was it? If her theory is correct, someone must have intervened.
strings.문득 궁금해졌소. 하지만, 나는 여기서 움직일 수 없는 몸. 그대가 한: Now I'm curious. But I cannot leave this place. I'd like your help once more.
strings.그때 나에게 가져다 주었던 마법사의 도구를 가져다 주시오. 그 도구에 사: Bring the mage's tool you brought before. I must examine the memories that remained in it, beyond the lingering thoughts.
A great mage of that land must have such tools. Please...
Well done. I'll call forth the memories within it.
strings.(사이암이 고개를 끄덕이고 마법사의 도구를 붙잡고 집중한다. 조금씩 사이: (Siam nods, takes the mage's tool, and concentrates. His brow gradually furrows and hardens.)
strings.도구에 깃든 기억은 정직하오. 특히 강한 힘을 가진 자의 도구는 필연적으: Memories within a tool do not lie. A tool belonging to someone powerful inevitably remembers its owner.
strings.이 도구는 자신의 주인이 위선자라 이야기하고 있소. 어떤 자의 도움을 받: This tool calls its master a hypocrite. With someone's help, he sacrificed people who sought justice and became a hero.
strings.이 도구에 그대로 남겨져 있어서 그렇소. 마법사에게 힘을 건넨 자는 나: It remains in the tool. The one who gave the mage power is like me, yet somewhat different.
strings.다른 세계에서 왔지만, 시간과 공간을 넘나들었소. 그 정도로 강한 힘을: From another world, but able to cross time and space. A being with power that great...
strings.(사이암의 말과 함께 누군가의 모습이 떠오른다. 얼마 전, 신의 나무 라: (Siam's words bring someone's face to mind. The one you met recently at the Divine Tree Lapier...)
You seem terribly afraid. It's all right. Tell me.
strings.(사이암에게 아드리카에서 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (You tell Siam what happened in Adrica.)
strings.아, 여신이시여…. 다른 세계의 존재가 이 세계를 위협하려고 있는 건 알: Ah, Goddess... I knew a being from another world threatened this one, but to appear directly...
strings.후우. 내 도움이 필요하다면 언제라도 찾아오시오. 내 기꺼이 도움이 되어: Sigh. If you need my help, come anytime. I'll gladly give it.
strings.그리고… 코랄시티의 역사학자에겐 적당히 이야기해주시오. 아직 확실하지 않: And... Be measured in what you tell the historian in Coral City. Nothing is certain yet. Say only that it is a possible hypothesis.
strings.네…. 고마워요, 사이암. 저도 사이암이 이 공간에서 나갈 수 있는 방법: I will... Thank you. I'll also look for a way to free you from this space.
strings.말씀만으로 고맙소. 이리스 양에게도 안부 전해주시오. 그리고 충분한 휴식: The thought alone is enough. Give Iris my regards. Get some proper rest, too. And travel safely.
strings.표정이 안 좋아 보이시는데, 무슨 일 있나요?: You don't look well. Did something happen?
strings.(표정을 보니 거짓말하시는 것 같네. 별 일 아니겠지.): (That expression looks like a lie. Hopefully it isn't serious.)
strings.생각나신 분에게는 다녀오셨나요? 혹시 사랑하는 사람?: Did you visit the person you thought of? Someone you love, perhaps?
strings.에이, 농담도…. 그냥 아는 마법사에요. 엘레나가 발견한 사실에 대한 조: Oh, you and your jokes... Just a mage I know, who offered advice about your discovery.
strings.그래서 그 마법사께서 어떤 이야기를 해주셨냐면요. 반대라면 어떻게 됐을까: He suggested a hypothesis in reverse.
strings.아틀란티스의 기술이 고대의 물건을 바탕으로 만들어졌다면 어떨 것 같냐면서: What if Atlantean technology had been based on ancient objects...?
strings.고대에는 유전자를 변이시킬 수 있는 기술이 없었어요. 신의 힘으로 변화가: There was no technology to alter genes in ancient times. Unless divine power caused the changes.
strings.혹시 신 같은 힘으로 시공간을 넘나드는 존재가 있을까요? 신님들조차도 그: Could there be a being who crosses time and space with godlike power? Even the gods don't seem able to do that...
strings.(엘레나는 뭔가 알고 있는 눈치네. 꽤 똑똑한 사람이니까. 그래도 이야기: (Elena seems to suspect something. She's clever. But I can't tell her.)
Then again, unbelievable things happened often in ancient times.
strings.모험가님, 죄송해요. 원래 제 일인데, 모험가님께 의존해서 쉽게 해결하려: I'm sorry, adventurer. This is my work, and perhaps I relied on you for an easy answer. Thank you.
strings.뭘요. 저도 그분을 만나러 간 김에 몰랐던 걸 잔뜩 물어봤거든요. 덕분에: It's all right. While visiting him, I asked plenty of things I didn't know. It helped me a great deal, too.
strings.확실히 뭔가 숨기고 계시다니까…. 그게 뭘까? 확실히 코랄시티 말고 이상: They're definitely hiding something... What could it be? There were other places with strange phenomena besides Coral City.
strings.산하고 사막이랬는데, 조금만 알아볼까?: A mountain and a desert, wasn't it? Perhaps I'll look into them a little...
